ValidationRule.description: Prevent the procession to quote complete until special pricing has been approved or denied
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Quote Complete"), OR( ISPICKVAL(Special_Pricing_Status__c, "Submitted"), ISPICKVAL(Special_Pricing_Status__c, "Pending") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Can not advance to Quote Complete Stage when special pricing has not been Approved or Denied
